prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Holiday ingredients tumbling onto the counter in slow motion — cinnamon sticks, cloves, chestnuts, dried fruit — bouncing and rolling in warm light. The camera follows butter melting in a wide pan, cassava flour cascading in, bacon bits folded through as everything toasts golden. Money shot: a wooden spoon lifting the golden farofa high, toasted grains falling back in slow motion like confetti, backlit. Final beat: a taste from the spoon, an approving pause, then a pen writing in an open notebook beside the stove — planning has begun. Warm festive light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the ingredients tumbling, then the toasting crackle. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Quem chega em dezembro tranquila é quem começou a pensar nele em novembro.

A ceia perfeita não nasce na véspera — nasce num domingo como hoje. Dezembro vem aí, e a gente vai chegar JUNTO.

Manda pra quem já tá sonhando com a ceia 👇
